Hero_Desc_Gabia:
An earth elemental of few words. It doesn't look like she's shy.
You just can't tell if she's talking because her voice is so small.
There are a few elementals who seem to understand what Gabia says.
Album_Gabia1: An earth elemental from the elemental community in Elias Forest. Communicating with Gabia is nearly impossible without a special interpreter. Sometimes, Naia, the water elemental, will play pranks on her. Judging from the way she screams from surprise, it seems she's just reticent.
Album_Gabia2: Surprisingly, communicating with the soft-spoken and reserved Gabia is pretty straightforward: Simply write on the ground. But it's frustrating that not everyone knows this is the way... I've never seen anyone attempt to do this.
Album_Gabia3: I asked Gabia if it bothers her when water or fire elementals sometimes unintentionally encroach on the land. She replied that such things are all part of nature's cycle, and that she has no complaints.
Album_Gabia4: Gabia enjoys lying quietly still in the dark underground, alone. When asked why, she said talking to someone tires her out. Compared to other, more active elementals, Gabia's personality is pretty unique.
Album_Gabia5: Gabia envies the animals who go underground to hibernate during the winter. She feels some sort of tranquility when she sees them, saying she wants to experience sleep herself. Elementals don't sleep, so she doesn't know how it feels to be asleep.
Album_Gabia6: Gabia claims she can hear the earth's heartbeat, by lying very still underground... I wonder if what she's hearing is actually her own heart...
Album_Gabia7: Gabia has a childhood memory of lying beside someone and gazing at the stars. She doesn't remember who that was, but she still recalls the deep sense of peace and reassurance she felt. Maybe that's why she has a habit of lying down.
Food_ChefNote_Gabia_Hate1:
After seeing the candy, Gabia put it in her pocket and whispered, "I will rescue you."
For some reason, I felt like she was glaring at me.
Food_ChefNote_Gabia_Hate2: After smelling the food, Gabia looks as if it reminds her of the stubborn fire elementals. She doesn't look very pleased.
Food_ChefNote_Gabia_Like1: It seems Gabia likes the fragrant lemon scent. She silently takes one sip after another.
Food_ChefNote_Gabia_Like2:
Gabia said she could feel the strong energy of the earth from this candy. 
Although the ingredients are all food additives from Monatium, I kept my mouth shut.
Food_ChefNote_Gabia_Like3: Gabia liked the food, thinking the shape reminded her of sand. She appreciated that someone made food just for her.
Food_ChefNote_Gabia_Like4: She mumbled something about enjoying the chewy texture as she ate.
Food_ChefNote_Gabia_Like5: She said it compensated for the nutrients lacking in her cave. She then chewed it thoroughly before swallowing.
Food_ChefNote_Gabia_Like6: Gabia's silent munching is adorable. She smiles broadly at me.
Food_ChefNote_Gabia_Like7: Gabia mumbled quietly but seemed to enjoy it a lot. Probably saying she liked it.
Food_ChefNote_Gabia_Like8: Gabia hesitated at first. After taking a bite, her expression really brightened. It seems like it was the first time I've seen her this happy.
Food_ChefNote_Gabia_Like9: Gabia tapped the table, smiling sheepishly, as if asking for more candy. When I pushed the basket toward her, she carefully selected a few colors.
Gabia_Spawn2: I... will be... in your... care.
Gabia_Affinity3: I like lying down. Just want to lie down and breathe.
Gabia_Affinity4: Sleeping too long might cause a sinkhole. Can't sleep for too long.
Gabia_Affinity5: Naia is too cheerful sometimes. It can be overwhelming.
Gabia_Affinity6: The earth has a heart too. If it bursts, it'd be a disaster.
Gabia_Affinity7: My heart shakes and my eyes flutter.
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Gabia_Skin1: Gabia has dressed for a picnic to celebrate the return of spring, as if on cue. Even if there is no cold winter in Elias, spring always comes back.
Gabia_Board_Skin1: Want to go for a walk...?
Gabia_Touch1_1_Skin1: You did that on purpose... didn't you...?
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Gabia_Skin2: Gabia tried copying the outfit from the package of a board game that the Chow Rebels like. She grins widely, saying she can stuff lots of earth elementals inside her hat.
Gabia_LevelUp_Skin2: Mmm...! I... won't be able to resist.
Gabia_HeroUpgrade_Skin2: I want... reach a higher rank...!
Gabia_Touch1_Skin2: My magic... isn't scary, is it...?
Gabia_Touch2_2_Skin2: I'll... cast a blessing on you...
Gabia_Ultimate1: The power... of earth... and stone...
Gabia_Birthday: Happy birthday... Mm, yes... H-happy birthday...
LoveLetter_Gabia: Playing only with earth elementals in the cave was starting to feel dull, but the meals you provided me and the conversations you had with me at the Banquet Hall brightened up my days.Being with you brings back memories of when Sylla, Naia, and Ifrit used to get along so well. Your cooking? It's hit and miss, but I always eat every last bite. Sometimes I sneak some back to the earth elementals, and they love it too.Let's spend time together again soon.
LoveCall_Gabia:
Hello... Master... Talking... is tiring, but on the phone... I have to talk, mm...

Every time... I feel grateful... to you, Master... You talk... with me a lot too, hmm... When I am... with you, I feel comfortable somehow...
Even when... I say nothing, it feels like... you understand everything...
So I want to spend... more, more time... with you... I have never had... a friend like you before...

Mm... I called... to say that.
I am embarrassed... because it feels like... such a small reason to call... But if you do not mind... I would like to call... from time to time.
May I... call you again... next time...?
Affinity_Gabia_EP01_002: I can't hear you. Speak up.
Affinity_Gabia_EP01_006: This thing in the display case? You want to eat this?
Affinity_Gabia_EP02_001: Gabia points a finger at me.
Affinity_Gabia_EP02_002: You want to know what my name is?
Affinity_Gabia_EP02_005: Gabia gives me a sour look.
Affinity_Gabia_EP02_007: Gabia blushes and lowers her head.
Affinity_Gabia_EP03_003: Gabia stares at the top of my head, looking puzzled.
Affinity_Gabia_EP03_005: Gabia frowns, not sure what I'm talking about.
Affinity_Gabia_EP03_007: Gabia looks a little surprised as if she didn't expect this answer.
Affinity_Gabia_EP04_007: Gabia looks surprised and proud that someone understands her.
Affinity_Gabia_EP05_001: Gabia excitedly pulls out a megaphone.
Affinity_Gabia_EP05_002: Unauthorized performances are not allowed in public.
Affinity_Gabia_EP05_003: Gabia trudges out of the banquet hall with her shoulders slumped.
Affinity_Gabia_EP05_004: Is there something you'd like to say?
Affinity_Gabia_EP05_006: A megaphone isn't enough. Let me put in a hearing aid, too.
Affinity_Gabia_EP05_007: Master!!! Huh? Did you just pass out?!
Affinity_Gabia_EP06_001: Gabia starts scribbling on the table.
Affinity_Gabia_EP06_002: Take her pen away and scold her.
Affinity_Gabia_EP06_003: Looking upset, Gabia mumbles something and storms out of the banquet hall angrily.
Affinity_Gabia_EP06_005:
Her scrawls are complete.
It looks like a picture of Gabia strangling me... no, we have our arms around each other's shoulders.
Affinity_Gabia_EP06_007:
Gabia sighs and goes somewhere else to scribble,
but gives up with a sour expression.
Affinity_Gabia_EP07_001: Gabia brings two stones and places them in front of me. What's this?
Affinity_Gabia_EP07_002: The shining stone looks like a gem. Point at that one.
Affinity_Gabia_EP07_003: Gabia shyly puts the gem in my hand and runs away.
Affinity_Gabia_EP07_004: The smooth stone looks like a viewing stone. Point at that one.
Affinity_Gabia_EP07_005:
Gabia mumbles with a proud look on her face and explains this and that about it.
I don't understand a single thing she said.
Affinity_Gabia_EP07_006: Grab both stones, one in each hand, and throw them at Gabia.
Affinity_Gabia_EP07_007: Gabia bursts into tears. Everyone around me boos at me.
Affinity_Gabia_EP08_001:
Gabia has brought a wooden board with letters on it.
I recognize this. It's a spirit board...
Affinity_Gabia_EP08_002: Hold the pen with Gabia and play along.
Affinity_Gabia_EP08_003:
One by one, letters are put together to form a sentence. "L-I-V-E T-O-G-E-T-H-E-R U-N-D-E-R T-H-E E-A-R-T-H F-O-R-E-V..."
I'd better run away.
Affinity_Gabia_EP08_004: You shouldn't believe in superstitions like this! These are for kids!
Affinity_Gabia_EP08_005: Gabia holds up the spirit board and panics, then breaks into a cold sweat and starts crying.
Affinity_Gabia_EP08_006: Gabia, if you want to tell me something, just say it.
Affinity_Gabia_EP08_007:
Gabia thinks hard for a moment and starts mumbling excitedly.
We should have just used the spirit board.
Affinity_Gabia_EP09_001: Gabia takes one bite of her food and gestures that she is full.
Affinity_Gabia_EP09_002: That bad? You're already tired of it?
Affinity_Gabia_EP09_003: Gabia makes a sour face. Guess that was the wrong thing to say.
Affinity_Gabia_EP09_004: You want me to wrap up the leftovers?
Affinity_Gabia_EP09_005: Gabia shakes her head no. Guess she's had enough.
Affinity_Gabia_EP09_006: You want to know if anyone leaves the free food unfinished?
Affinity_Gabia_EP09_007:
Gabia nods and makes a stern face.
If you throw your food waste on the ground, you'll get in trouble.
Affinity_Gabia_EP10_001: Gabia has brought me a letter, but it's blank inside.
Affinity_Gabia_EP10_002: Is this a secret letter that reveals writing when held near a flame? Let's see...
Affinity_Gabia_EP10_003: The letter burns. There is no secret writing. Gabia cries so hard that I have a hard time comforting her...
Affinity_Gabia_EP10_004: You want me to write you a letter with this?
Affinity_Gabia_EP10_005: I draw her a raccoon on the blank sheet of paper and she goes home with a happy smile on her face.
Affinity_Gabia_EP10_006: I could make a nice paper plane with this.
Affinity_Gabia_EP10_007:
I fold a paper airplane with it and let it fly. The plane crashes into the fireplace and burns to ashes.
Gabia glowers at me for a long time.
Affinity_Gabia_EP11_001: Gabia shifts her eyes from left to right.
Affinity_Gabia_EP11_003: Gabia quietly says "salty." I guess today's food didn't suit her taste.
Affinity_Gabia_EP11_004: Do you have something in your eyes?
Affinity_Gabia_EP11_005: When I try to blow on her eyes, Gabia pulls back. She must have been startled as her face turned red.
Affinity_Gabia_EP11_006: Move my finger following the movement of her pupils.
Affinity_Gabia_EP11_007: Gabia headbutts my finger. I don't know what that was about, but I guess that wasn't it.
Affinity_Gabia_EP12_001: Gabia is laying something out on the table. Are those pebbles?
Affinity_Gabia_EP12_002: Try playing a game of jacks with the stones.
Affinity_Gabia_EP12_003: I hear tiny squeaking sounds from the back of my hand. They're lesser earth elementals.
Affinity_Gabia_EP12_004: Pick up a stone and put it in my mouth.
Affinity_Gabia_EP12_005: Gabia's eyes grow wide as she smacks the back of my head. The lesser earth elementals come tumbling out of my mouth.
Affinity_Gabia_EP12_006: Roll a stone around in my hand.
Affinity_Gabia_EP12_007: I hear a giggling sound from my hand. It was a Lesser Earth Elemental. Gabia's face lights up with pride.
Affinity_Gabia_EP13_001: Gabia suddenly stares blankly at the table.
Affinity_Gabia_EP13_003: Gabia nods in satisfaction. Someone must have spilled food.
Affinity_Gabia_EP13_004: Sprinkle flour on the dining table.
Affinity_Gabia_EP13_005: Gabia gives me a look that says "What are you doing?"
Affinity_Gabia_EP13_006: I lower my head to match her eye level and give her a smile.
Affinity_Gabia_EP13_007: Gabia is startled at first, then looks at my face carefully and responds with a smile.
Affinity_Gabia_EP14_001: Gabia coughs. Did she catch a cold?
Affinity_Gabia_EP14_002: Ask if she wants to go to Hilde.
Affinity_Gabia_EP14_003: Gabia shakes her head from side to side, clearly displeased.
Affinity_Gabia_EP14_004: Open the window to let in some fresh air.
Affinity_Gabia_EP14_005: Gabia seems to feel a little better, but she continues coughing.
Affinity_Gabia_EP14_007: Gabia drinks the water and quietly says thank you. It seems she choked on her food.
Affinity_Gabia_EP15_001: Gabia is tilting her plate this way and that.
Affinity_Gabia_EP15_002: Since Gabia is an earth elemental, pour some soil onto her plate.
Affinity_Gabia_EP15_003: Gabia builds a small castle with the pile of dirt and happily plays house.
Affinity_Gabia_EP15_004: Take a closer look at Gabia's plate.
Affinity_Gabia_EP15_005: She was playing by rolling small stones around on the plate. They seem to be little earth elementals.
Affinity_Gabia_EP15_006: Snatch the plate away and put it in the sink.
Affinity_Gabia_EP15_007: Gabia tries to take the plate back but it's no use. She starts crying loudly.
Affinity_Gabia_EP16_002: Could it be that you think the food is bad and I should quit?
Affinity_Gabia_EP16_003: Gabia looks troubled. She goes "Mmm... yum..." So, does that mean the food is delicious?
Affinity_Gabia_EP16_004: Are you worried this is going to go up in flames?
Affinity_Gabia_EP16_005: At the mention of "flames", Gabia looks around nervously, as if scanning the area for any sign of Ifrit.
Affinity_Gabia_EP16_006: Are you worried about not being so popular with the others?
Affinity_Gabia_EP16_007: Gabia's face turns bright red and she bursts into tears. I think I said something wrong.
Affinity_Gabia_EP17_001: Gabia is rubbing the water spilled on the table with her finger.
Affinity_Gabia_EP17_002: Stop that, you're making a mess!
Affinity_Gabia_EP17_003: Gabia sulks. It seems like she was just playing by herself.
Affinity_Gabia_EP17_004: Oh my, I'm sorry! Some other customer must have spilled some water.
Affinity_Gabia_EP17_005: Gabia nods with a pleased expression. It seems I handled that well.
Affinity_Gabia_EP17_006: Fill a bucket with water and pour it over her.
Affinity_Gabia_EP17_007: After getting doused with water, Gabia's eyes widen. She stares directly into my eyes for a long while.
Affinity_Gabia_EP18_002: "For you"? Do you want to give me something?
Affinity_Gabia_EP18_003: Gabia hands me a crumpled note. It says "Delicious".
Affinity_Gabia_EP18_004: "Fork...you"? Is this place so bad, you're trying to insult the cook?
Affinity_Gabia_EP18_005: Gabia frantically waves her hands with a flustered expression. Maybe my joke went too far.
Affinity_Gabia_EP18_006: "For real, your portions have gotten smaller"? Do you think so?
Affinity_Gabia_EP18_007: Gabia hangs her head low with a rather coy expression.
Affinity_Gabia_EP19_001: Gabia sits with her eyes closed. It looks like she's finished eating...
Affinity_Gabia_EP19_002: Are you trying to take a nap?
Affinity_Gabia_EP19_003: Gabia puffs out her cheeks. She says she was listening to the sounds of the earth. So she was working.
Affinity_Gabia_EP19_005: Gabia smacks her lips. In a dazed state, she begins pondering something deeply.
Affinity_Gabia_EP19_006: Leave her alone until she opens her eyes.
Affinity_Gabia_EP19_007: After a while, Gabia opens her eyes and looks as if she were grateful for not having been disturbed.
Affinity_Gabia_EP20_001: Gabia brings a strange device. It has "Thought-to-Speech Converter" written on it.
Affinity_Gabia_EP20_002: What's that device? Did you buy it from the elves?
Affinity_Gabia_EP20_004: You bought this because you want to have a more natural conversation?
Affinity_Gabia_EP20_006: You could just write on paper.
